plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: the cutting room as the first screen, what you make with your own "from" prices and a first-appointment request on WhatsApp, how a commission runs in five lines, and a Plan your visit page with every question.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: the cloth book on the home page with every weave full screen, "Ask for a swatch" and a set of up to five cloths asked for in one message, the cloth library by season, the bespoke process, trunk shows by city, what you make with a page per garment, bespoke or made to measure explained, the journal and gift vouchers (pick any four).
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: your commission by code, stage by stage with the next fitting in the calendar and a reminder the evening before of what to bring; the specification card, chosen from your own photographs (a shirt's collar too) and sent on WhatsApp or printed for the first fitting; the wedding party planner, every fitting for the whole party in one calendar file; ordering again from the client's pattern by order code; the style lexicon; and something made just for your house.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds up to four more pages, like this one: the cloth library, the process, trunk shows, what you make, bespoke explained, the journal or gift vouchers.
